description: This file implements an example IPC server and client using socket pairs, with a custom service 'MyExampleService' that performs an echo operation transforming input text to uppercase. It includes socket communication setup, spawning a client process, and handling RPC calls with protobuf-generated classes.

classes.name: MyExampleService
classes.description: A custom IPC service implementing the ExampleService interface, providing an echo method that converts input text to uppercase and responds.

methods.name: exampleEcho
methods.description: Handles an RPC call to echo a string in uppercase, logs the request and response.

methods.name: onComplete
methods.description: Callback invoked when an RPC call completes, sets the 'done' flag to true.

methods.name: childProcessMain
methods.description: Main function executed in the spawned client process, creates an IPC channel, makes an example RPC call, and handles response or error.

methods.name: spawnClient
methods.description: Forks and executes a new process to run the client, passing the socket file descriptor.

methods.name: clientDisconnected
methods.description: Callback invoked when a client disconnects, logs client process and user IDs.
